item.title: 从头开始搜索：语言模型的搜索本机预训练 建议将网络搜索查询和检索结果添加到普通预
item.description:
从头开始搜索：语言模型的搜索本机预训练

建议将网络搜索查询和检索结果添加到普通预训练文本中，以便模型从一开始就学会搜索。经过监督微调后，这种好处仍然存在。

📝 https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26809

Search From the Start: Search-Native Pretraining for Language Models

Proposes adding web search queries and retrieved results to ordinary pretraining text so models learn to search from the start. The benefit persists after supervised fine-tuning.

📝 https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26809

item.description:
Search-RSI：沿着多模式代理的能力前沿扩展搜索世界

为搜索代理引入了一个自我改进循环，该循环添加了带有所需证据的培训任务，因此正确的搜索不会因缺少证据而受到惩罚。

📝 https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27780

Search-RSI: Expanding Search Worlds Along Multimodal Agents’ Capability Frontier

Introduces a self-improvement loop for search agents that adds training tasks with the evidence they need, so correct searches aren't penalized for missing evidence.
